answer: By the dawn of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the opal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the prism of the next round.
